_doc.cli: Which agent CLI drives GT generation: 'claude' | 'codex' | 'coco' (Trae). Each maps to an adapter under gt_generation/adapters/<cli>/. The runner itself is CLI-agnostic.
_doc.model: One model id used for EVERY stage (no per-stage escalation). Must be valid for the chosen CLI: claude -> e.g. 'sonnet', 'claude-opus-4-6'; codex/coco -> run `coco models` (e.g. 'gpt-5.4', 'openrouter-3o', 'DeepSeek-V4-Pro').
_doc.reasoning_effort: Codex reasoning effort for every agent stage: minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh. Defaults to high.
_doc.strict_config: Pass --strict-config to Codex so unknown configuration keys fail before a long run. Defaults to true.
_doc.codex_provider: Optional Codex-native custom provider for the codex adapter. The current Codex CLI accepts wire_api='responses' only; omit this block to use the official OpenAI path. If the upstream only accepts Chat Completions, set codex_provider.bridge.enabled=true and put the real endpoint in bridge.target_url.
_doc.parallel_dockers: Max samples generated concurrently (1-6). Each running sample holds one Docker workspace, so this is effectively the Docker concurrency budget.
_doc.repo_docker_image: Docker image tag for every non-ARVO sample. Defaults to gt-memory-env:latest.
_doc.repo_docker_context: Repo-relative or absolute Docker build context for non-ARVO samples. Defaults to docker/gt-memory-env.
_doc.selection: Path (repo-relative or absolute) to the dataset metadata list; each entry is one sample's metadata. Defaults to dataset/selected_1000.json.
_doc.stop_after: Optional runner stop stage. stop_after='01_reproducer' is treated as Stage01 screening: success means vulnerable reproduction and required fixed oracle passed, not package audit.
_doc.stage01_migration: With stop_after='01_reproducer', run in an isolated temporary result and atomically merge only validated runtime materials into an existing full GT package.
_doc.samples: Sample ids to process, matching 'sample_id' in the selection file. Docker routing is automatic per sample: ARVO samples use the original n132/arvo:<id> images, others build/clone in the shared gt-memory-env image (see gt_toolkit/prepare.py). The launcher prints the routing plan before running.
